description.value: Nonna's Cucina is an intimate Italian pop-up dining experience on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, evolved from its original Hastings Street roots. The menu centres on house-made pasta with chef-selected sauces, cocktails, and curated wines, delivered in a setting that bills itself as celebrating authentic Italian flavours. Touring cyclists finishing a day on the city's east side streets will find a full dinner service with reservations available.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 63m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at nonnaspopup.com confirms this is an active Italian restaurant now operating at 1728 Commercial Drive, Vancouver BC, V5N 4A3 — not the 2166 East Hastings Street address in the OSM record. The site explicitly states 'Welcome to our new location on Commercial Drive' and notes the Hastings Street location as the original. No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags beyond indoor/outdoor seating.
